check_file_content: check if a file's content matches expected content and optionally update it
update_file_content: update a file to match expected content ensuring it ends with a newline
format_source_code: format python source code using Ruff linter and formatter
validate_file_content: validate file content against expected string and exit on mismatch
run_ruff_format: run Ruff check and format on generated python source code
